name: Hailfade
tagline: Reads dips in a Starlink dish's link quality as an early hail warning for farms
description: Heavy precipitation degrades a satellite link in a recognisable way, and this turns that dip into a warning: yellow as the connection starts to suffer, red when it looks like hail. Setup guidance is included, so this is not a weekend project. A farm with a dish mounted gets a crude storm sensor at no extra cost.
author: LaLascaux
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
